business_summary: Oklo Inc. (NYSE: OKLO) is a pre-commercial developer of small fast-fission reactors (the Aurora powerhouse), targeting onsite power for data centers among other customers. It is pre-revenue: SEC companyfacts carries no Revenues figure for this issuer, and both operating income and net income are losses in every reported fiscal year. Its ai-infrastructure exposure is a named collaboration with Vertiv on power and cooling for hyperscale and colocation data centers.
